name: Expanded Matter
//: Crushed and powdered ores, metals and stones, ashes, lyes and the extra minerals. The mod's crushing and grinding recipes value nearly all of these already; these are the fallback. A crushed or powdered ore is worth the base game's nugget of it (the mod smelts them like nuggets: 20 to an ingot), crushed metal a twentieth of the ingot, crushed stone a rock, ashes 2. Minerals with no vanilla nugget copy vintagee-emc.json's defaultValues for their ore blocks. Only used when nothing else values the item; the '//' lines say why each number was chosen.

defaultValues.//crushed-ore-*: an ore with no vanilla nugget: between a copper nugget (6.4) and a tin one (12.8)
defaultValues.//powdered-ore-lapislazuli: a pigment ore, a bit above kernite (40)
defaultValues.//powdered-ore-cinnabar: a rare pigment ore: like corundum (64)
defaultValues.//powdered-ore-boneash: two thirds of a bone (24), burnt
defaultValues.//powdered-ore-yellowcake: refined uranium: like a gem-grade material (amethyst 128)
defaultValues.//crushed-metal-*: a metal with no vanilla ingot: like a generic nugget (8)
defaultValues.//crushed-metal-temporal: a twentieth of a temporal gear (4096), as crushed metal is of an ingot; a bit more since gears aren't ingots
defaultValues.//crushed-metal-rusty: a twentieth of a rusty gear's ~46
defaultValues.//crushed-metal-titanium: a twentieth of a titanium ingot valued between steel (512) and gold (2048)
defaultValues.//crushed-metal-uranium: a twentieth of a uranium ingot valued a bit above titanium
defaultValues.//ash-*: ash: a few burnt sticks' worth, between leaves (1) and soil (4)
defaultValues.//ash-organic-sludge: ash soaked and settled: twice ash
defaultValues.//pigment-*: a pigment: like a flower (16), the game's dye source
defaultValues.//ore-*: an ore block with no vanilla twin: like the game's iron ores (16)

litreValues.//*brineportion: brine per litre: twice salt water (1)
litreValues.//*acidportion: like the game's acid (64), per litre of the weaker portion
litreValues.//mercuryportion: mercury per litre: as the item

relativeValues.//: a crushed ore is one nugget of it (20 to an ingot, as the mod's bloomery takes them)
powdering doesn't add metal: still one nugget
a twentieth of the ingot: one nugget's worth of metal
crushed stone is still a rock (1)
powdered stone is still a rock (1)
the mod's ingot of a vanilla metal is the vanilla ingot
the mod's nugget of a vanilla ore is the vanilla nugget
the mod's ore block of a vanilla ore is the vanilla one
the mod's metal bits are the vanilla ones
